name: Loretta
personality: Lively, stubborn and competitive, with a serious fear of ghosts.
story: A former street orphan who stole to survive (and bears a scar from past punishment) before finding work at the Credna Temple in Dagsion. Ozin taught her self-defense, and she devotedly follows Orchel, calling them "Priest." Recruiting her costs 3 Iron Swords on some routes.

personalSkill.name: Steadfast
personalSkill.effect: If unit's HP >= 50%, grants Avo+10 during combat. Lv 20: Peak Form (Atk +3 at full HP); Lv 35: Peak Form+ (Atk +3, Avo +10 at full HP).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (speedster, 55% Spd, reliable evasion). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

guide.summary: The strike group's dodger from Ch 8: she doubles with a light sword and stacks Avo +30 from Steadfast, Peak Form+, Swords Lv. 3 and her ring while her HP is full. Attack only from 100% HP, end beside Alexandra and Ultand, and let Sofia's range-3 Heal top her up.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: top her to 100%, double with the Da Mina Sword (Haze Slice on risky targets: Hit +10 on arts), then end beside Alexandra and Ultand. Enemy phase: Avo does the work; Sniper Evasion covers Onagers and Longbows at 3+ tiles.
keys: Recruit her late Ch 7 or 6/1: Support 3, Renown 5, 3 Iron Swords
Buy a 4th [[item:Iron Sword]] for her join; [[item:Da Mina Sword]] at Sword C (Ch 9): +1 then, +2 in Ch 12 (Mt 20)
Book Arena Infantry each week until Lv 20: Sword C and Infantry C
Attack only at 100% HP: [[ability:Peak Form+]] gives Atk +3 and Avo +10
End beside Alexandra (her Silver Maiden +5) and Ultand (Patch Up heals Loretta)
Take [[class:Sword Master]] in Section 3: her endpoint (Dietrich holds [[class:The Blade]], D-143)
watch: Weight: Iron or Da Mina Sword 4 + Phantom Ring 3 = 7; Flyssa 4 + ring = 7. Ring off first on offense maps. Part III S4: Da Mina Sword +2 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 6, Spd +3.
HP: Peak Form+ needs exactly 100%; one chip costs Atk +3 and Avo +10 until healed.
Def: 30 growth, Shido +0. Two hits put her under 50% and Steadfast's Avo +10 goes too.
Join level: about Lv 15 at Ch 8, ~10 under the core. Feed her kills to Lv 20.
Inventory: 3 core (Da Mina Sword, Phantom Ring, Concoction); Flyssa and Cleansing Blade swap in.

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Tobias and Ultand. Meal seat: Theodora + Loretta + Ultand; Ultand beside her on the map also fires Patch Up.
On foot all game, so she carries [[battalion:Hunter-Drifters]] (Str/Spd/Dex +1). She drops first if fewer battalions deploy (count ?).
End turns beside [[unit:Alexandra]]: each neighbour gives her Silver Maiden Hit/Avo +5. Ultand on the other side keeps Loretta at 100%.

decisions.pick: Support 3, Renown 5, 3 Iron Swords; deploy from Ch 8
decisions.why: Core 11 strike dodger (D-130). An early join trains Sword C by Lv 20 and builds the Tobias and Ultand supports; a Ch 10 join auto-levels on personal growths, 3 to 4 points short per stat.
decisions.else: Support 3 late? Recruit the week it lands

decisions.topic: Take Hunter for the Beginner stage
decisions.pick: Hunter (Bow D, Sword D) unless she joins in it
decisions.why: Trains Sword +1 and Infantry +1 (Evasion D, Dodge C, Sniper Evasion B) and grows HP/Spd/Dex +10. Soldier trains Heavy, her bane, at Spd −5; Gladiator trains Axe and Gauntlet she never uses.

decisions.topic: Stay on foot to Sword Master
decisions.why: Infantry ranks are her Avo (Dodge, Sniper Evasion), she can carry a battalion, and the sword line grows Spd +15 to +20. Wing Soldier makes a third flier and loses both.

decisions.pick: Heal her before she attacks; Ultand adjacent
decisions.why: Peak Form+ (Atk +3, Avo +10) needs 100% HP and Steadfast (Avo +10) 50%+. Patch Up heals her after each fight beside Ultand; Sofia's Heal reaches 3 tiles. One chip costs her Avo +10.

decisions.pick: Sword Master in S3; The Blade only as Dietrich's fallback
decisions.why: D-143 gives the Demonic Swordguard to Dietrich, a lord with a fixed Balor seat and a crit engine. Astra and Spd +20 growth carry her in squad A; keep training Sword toward S in case his exam falls short.
decisions.else: Dietrich's Sword short of S at Section 5: she takes The Blade
